title: Retro Snake
description: Maneuver the green serpent to eat apples, grow longer, and avoid running into the walls or yourself.
controls: Arrow keys or WASD to move. Space to pause.

title: 2048 Puzzle
description: Slide numbered tiles across the board and merge identical values until you achieve the coveted 2048 tile.
controls: Arrow keys, WASD, or swipe to slide tiles.

title: Flappy Pixel
description: Flap your wings to navigate through narrow pipe openings in this challenging retro arcade trial.
controls: Spacebar, Up Arrow, or Click/Tap to flap.

title: Retro Pong
description: The quintessential table tennis duel. Challenge the smart AI paddle or play against a friend locally.
controls: W/S for Player 1, Up/Down for Player 2 (or against AI).

title: Brick Breaker
description: Launch the ball and bounce it with your paddle to demolish every brick in the wall without letting it drop.
controls: Left / Right arrows, A/D, or mouse movement to control paddle.

title: Tetra Blocks
description: Strategically guide and rotate falling geometric tetromino blocks to clear horizontal rows and rack up points.
controls: Left/Right to move, Up to rotate, Down for soft drop, Space for hard drop.

title: Desert Dino Run
description: Sprint endlessly through the arid desert, timing leaps over spiky cacti and ducking under swooping pterodactyls.
controls: Space or Up Arrow to jump, Down Arrow to duck.

title: Minesweeper
description: Uncover safe squares on the minefield using numerical clues while marking suspicious spots with warning flags.
controls: Left click to reveal, Right click (or Hold / Flag toggle) to place flag.
